answer: Stop sybils with a prism split: an agent locks one bond, prism-split into three shards held by separate verifiers. Its ripple proof must match all three shards; a mismatch or reused shard slashes the bond and voids both. Forging 1,000 pays 1,000 bonds, shards, and proofs at 17x honest cost each: each shard fits one agent and one bond, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents pay once and trade undiluted from the ocean vault.
